senses.gloss: (כשש; cmp. גִּשְׁגֵּשׁ) to knock, strike, move to and fro, shake.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 20a:12">Bets. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ להם בזנבה</he> (Ms. M. <he>כ׳ לה</he>) he made for them (in their presence) striking movements with the animal’s tail (making believe it was a female); Y. ib. II, 61ᶜ top <he>התחיל מְכַשְׁכֵּשׁ בזנבה</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:3:5">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> bot.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:6">Ḥull. II, 6</cite> <he>עד שׁתְּכַשְׁכֵּשׁ בזנבה</he> unless the animal strikes about with its tail (an evidence of vitality).
<cite ref="Chullin 38a:1">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite> top <he>כִּישְׁכְּשָׁה באזנה</he> if it shook its ears (with vital force).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 2:1:5">Y. B. Kam. II, beg. 2ᵈ</cite>; Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:3">B. Kam. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ בזנבה</he> if the beast struck (and did damage) with its tail.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ באמתה</he> (v. <cite ref="K01309">preced.</cite>) if she struck (and did damage) with her fore-leg.—V. <cite ref="U01193"><he>שִׁכְשֵׁךְ</he> II</cite>.—[

senses.gloss: (= שִׁכְשֵׁךְ; cmp. גִּעְגֵּעַ) to soothe, pat. Pesik. Zakh. p. 24ᵇ (את) מְכַשְׁכְּשׁוֹ, v. שִׁכְשֵׁךְ I.]
